==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Win 3 battles in Codex Arena.
* *BONUS* 5 battles in a row in Codex Arena.
* *BONUS* Win 9 battles in Codex Arena.
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen Challenge Quests|Zaishen Challenge]]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* 6,000 [[Balthazar Faction]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 25 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.
